title: MZ Icon Indicators similar to what Yanfly's Instant Cast plugin can do

posts.author: Hexx_Vixtar
posts.body:
A bit of context:
In RPG Maker MV, there's a plugin from Yanfly called the "Instant Cast" plugin. This plugin allows the dev to designate certain skill and/or items to be used in battle without using their turn.
However!
that's not what this request is about, the request instead is about a specific feature that the Instant Cast plugin have, an
Icon Indicator
.
Unless the dev specify each and ever skill that can be instantly cast in the help window, the player has no way to know if a skill and/or item use will or will not use up their turn. So how do the plugin help with this? By giving the option to set an additional icon that sits on top of the base icon which helps indicate skill/item that can be instantly cast
Spoiler:
Example
Screenshot directly taken from Yanfly's Instant Cast tutorial video. the top skill (Cure) is a skill that can be instantly cast without wasting a turn while the bottom skill (Curaga) isn't and using it will use up the character's  turn.
The IconSet used, as you can see the icon for the skill and the indicator are separate icons, but using the plugin the icons get layered on top of each other.
This indicator can help directly tell the player the unique property of the skill/item without needing to write a description on every singly skill/item's help window, and that is what this request is about.
The Request:
So here's my request. a plugin for RMMZ that can layer different icon together to help give additional information to the player without needing to write additional information in the help window.
This could be use, like the Instant Cast above, to help indicate additional information about a skill, like for example, if the skill is a multi-elemental skill (skill that uses 2 elements in its damage calculation), the cooldown of the skill, whether the skill is physical, magical, or special, and so on.
Spoiler:
Example
The top skill does fire & water elemental damage
The middle shows a 1 turn CD
The bottom shows a physical, magical, and special fire skill
It doesn't have to be just for skills either, maybe you want to give items or equipment a rarity. instead of writing down "Common" or "Rare" on every item's help window, you could show it off with an indicator. and the great part about this is that you can reduce the amount of icons you need for the IconSet
Spoiler:
Example
Assuming you have 5 different rarity, you can turn a simple weapon icon into 5 different icons, with the more weapon icon you use the more space you saved up (3 weapon + 5 rarity is already 15 difference icon combination, with 5 weapon it's 25 icons, and 10 weapons give 50 icons. All this icons while you only used up 8, 10, and 15 icon slot in your IconSet respectively)
Additionally, if the plugins allow you to stack multiple indicators together, you can turn a small set of icons into multiple different icons ready to be used for different skills.
Spoiler:
Example
Just 1 fire icon with a few indicators and produce a lot of different icons should the indicators be stackable (like a normal fire skill, a fire skill that also does water damage, a fire skill that also does water damage with a 1 turn cooldown, a fire skill with a 1 turn cooldown, a physical fire skill that also does water damage, etc)
By having indicators, we can easily tell players what certain skill and item does even if we don't have enough space to explain it in the help window. it also gives us a bit more freedom in what we type in the help window, like giving a more in-depth explanation to what the skill/item/equipment does or gives more space to give some flavor text to the skill/item/equipment that could help more with world building and the sorts.
Additional (Possible) Features:
Additional features that the plugin could have would also be a background indicator. so instead of the indicator being on top of the icon, there's an indicator behind the icon. you
could
do this without background indicator (instead of using (for example) a sword as base and a background color as indicator, you use the background as base and the sword as an indicator instead) but you're more likely to accidentally edit the wrong skill/item/equipment because all you see is a background.
a 2nd additional feature is to let the indicator be a multiple or add layer, so instead of completely covering the icon, it alters how the base icon looked like.
Final Words:
This is the first time I'm asking to make a plugin completely from scratch as I don't think there's any plugin that does something similar to this beside Yanfly's Instant Cast plugin (or at least I couldn't find this kind of plugin from what I've search). The closest I find to something similar to this is VisuStella's Visual Item Inventory plugin, but that only changes the background of the items, it doesn't have any icon indicator capability, that is why I'm asking here to see if it's possible to make icon indicators and if anyone can code it into a plugin (I'm still relatively new to javascript so I don't think I have the capability to make custom plugin at the moment)
Thank you for reading this far, hope you have a great day
